text:
You want an AI workflow that learns from past bookkeeping transactions, prompts for confirmation before posting, extracts invoice fields into Xero, and handles custom currency cases like USD-to-AUD conversion.  

I can help build that. I have 6 years of experience with Python, PyTorch, scikit-learn, LangChain, OpenAI API, Hugging Face Transformers, NLP, XGBoost, pandas, and machine learning, and I’ve built invoice automation for accounting workflows. For Ledgerline Accounting, I built a service that reads scanned supplier invoices and returns vendor, dates, totals, and line items as JSON using Python, Tesseract, LayoutLMv3, Hugging Face Transformers, FastAPI, and Docker. It achieved 96.2% field-level accuracy on 1,800 test invoices and cut manual data entry by about 70%.  

I’d recommend an MVP that first classifies similar transactions, then surfaces a human review step before completion, and adds invoice text extraction plus custom rules for edge cases.
